# sh-list-grouped

**Purpose:** Rows that share one outline, like a settings group. Part of sh-list — place sh-list and pick its Type; edit these options under Row.

**Position:** Single (alone, all corners round) · Start (top) · Middle · End (bottom).

**Title icon:** colour icon/tertiary (a hint, e.g. info).

Core · 4 variants · [Open in Figma](https://www.figma.com/design/l1SuD1Q1l8QXGvtomszGYW/Shaadi-DNA?node-id=3322-75528) (node `3322:75528`)

*Generated by `tools/components.py` from Figma. Values are token names; never copy numbers.*

## Types

### Position=Single

sh-list · Grouped · Single

**Purpose:** a lone row inside its own outline.

### Position=Start

sh-list · Grouped · Start

**Purpose:** first row of an outlined group: outline on top and sides, rounded top corners.

### Position=Middle

sh-list · Grouped · Middle

**Purpose:** a row between the first and last of an outlined group: outline on the sides only.

### Position=End

sh-list · Grouped · End

**Purpose:** last row of an outlined group: outline on sides and bottom, rounded bottom corners.

## Anatomy

Layer tree of `Position=Single`. Nested components are shown by name; their internals live in their own blueprint.

- root — column
  - Row — row · fill × hug
    - Content — column · fill × hug
      - Title row — row · fill × hug
        - Title — text "Title"
        - Title icon — **sh-icon/information-circle** (Type Line, Size 16) · hidden by default
      - Subtitle — text "Subtitle" · hidden by default
    - Trailing — row · hug × hug
      - Trailing icon — **sh-icon/arrow-right-01** (Type Line, Size 20)
  - Divider — **sh-divider** (Orientation Horizontal, Type Soft) · hidden by default
